action_items: Bug fixed in this iteration (no main agent action required for it). Verify the GET /api/sales serialization fix is acceptable and consider adding the same batch_id/batch_index/batch_total fields to GET /api/sales/recent (used by Calculator 'Stampe Recenti') if you want recent prints to also show their batch grouping.

(Optional polish) When a user reprints a batched sale (e.g. 3/3), the quantity field on the Calculator is NOT pre-filled because handleReprint() does not pass quantity in the JSON. Consider passing rp.quantity = sale.batch_total when sale.batch_index === 1 (or always 1) so a re-print of a batch row defaults sensibly.
(Optional polish) PATCH /api/sales/{id} returns only {message}; consider returning the updated document so frontend doesn't need to recompute net_profit locally.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG (FIXED HERE): GET /api/sales did not include batch_id, batch_index, batch_total in the response. Frontend SalesPage uses sale.batch_total > 1 to gate rendering of the index badge, so badges never appeared on real saved batches even though the data was persisted correctly. Patched server.py around line 800 to include the 3 fields. Verified 1/3, 2/3, 3/3 badges now visible.

PATCH /api/sales/{id} (server.py ~826) updates sale_price and recomputes net_profit but does NOT recompute related fields like total_cost or filament_cost — acceptable today (cost is fixed at print time), but if filament prices change in future this means edits won't reflect new costs. Document this assumption.

POST /api/sales batch logic (server.py ~931) generates batch_id from datetime.now+ObjectId[:6]. If two simultaneous batches are created in the same second by the same user the batch_id collides on the timestamp prefix; uniqueness still holds due to the ObjectId suffix, but switch to a pure str(ObjectId()) for clarity.
3MF unsliced detection (server.py ~2123) re-opens the zip a second time to inspect file_list. Refactor to capture namelist() once at the start of import_3mf and reuse — minor perf/code-quality nit.
server.py is now ~2240 lines — past the 700-line guideline. Splitting into routers (auth, sales, calculator, import, admin) is overdue.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (reprint, edit dialog, batch badges all verified after fix)

rca of the issue: Symptom: After saving a print with quantity=3 from Calculator, Sales page showed 3 separate rows (correct) but no '1/3, 2/3, 3/3' badge. Reproduction: POST /api/sales with quantity=3, then GET /api/sales -> response items missing batch_total/batch_index. Frontend conditional `{sale.batch_total > 1 && <Badge>...}` therefore never rendered. Root cause: GET /api/sales explicit field whitelist (server.py ~781) was not updated when batch fields were added to the documents in POST /api/sales. Mitigation: added 3 fields to the projected response. Verified end-to-end with browser screenshot showing the badges 1/3, 2/3, 3/3 next to TEST_BATCH_BADGE_FIX rows.
